student.architecture: one-layer unidirectional GRU residual over a trainable affine path
student.output: fixed normalized public embedding table, unrestricted full-vocabulary logits
student.input: activation prefix H[0:i+1], record-reset sequence, no source tokens/teacher/candidates/feedback
student.initialization: public PR7 affine W,b,s; W,b,s remain trainable in every arm

student_d.loss: student_h + 0.25 * weighted adjacent non-gold pairwise ranking
student_d.sigma_q: single median nonzero adjacent non-gold score gap from 384 qualification rows

paired_schedule.checkpoint_selection: earliest public-validation checkpoint with best style-balanced token accuracy; step zero retained on regression

teacher.native_anchor: separate evaluator-side A1+A2 reference; never an inference dependency

runtime.preflight: qualify largest representative graph before full paired matrix; fail closed on nonfinite/allocator/driver/resource anomaly

artifacts.candidate_ids: created once before fitting and bound to affine/table source hashes
artifacts.states: one create-only selected.safetensors and final.safetensors per method/seed
artifacts.predictions: evaluator-owned JSONL under frozen prediction roots
artifacts.private_truth: never loaded by training or teacher
